answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The resilience comes from slashing: dishonest approval costs more than the gain from a single manipulated verdict, so rational attackers stay honest. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds. Consider a lagoon as the anchor of the cost.
